annotations.title: chainpeek: USD price and pool liquidity of a Solana token by mint, read from chain

description: chainpeek: Get the USD price and liquidity of a Solana token by mint address. For large recent trades use get_large_solana_token_trades. Returns its USD price and the liquidity of its deepest pool. Spot price of one pool, computed from on-chain accounts, cached 15 s; Raydium, Orca and Meteora pools against USDC, USDT or SOL only; no pool is a 422 no_pool and an unreachable pool list or stale oracle a 503 (neither charged). Solana mainnet, confirmed commitment. A malformed input is a 422 before payment and a failing RPC read a 503 (neither charged). Typically 1-4 s. Price: USD 0.005. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/solana-token-price-api.html

mint.description: SPL Token or Token-2022 mint address (base58) of the token to price.
mint.title: Mint
